entropy.serialization: UTF-8 compact JSON, keys lexicographically sorted recursively, no whitespace, one terminal LF. Rationals are reduced numerator/positive-denominator strings including integers as a/1. No floats.
entropy.characteristic_polynomial: All dimension+1 coefficients of det(xI-rho), descending powers, rational strings.
entropy.spectrum: Array of {root: root object, multiplicity: positive integer}; rationals first by exact value, then quadratics by center, radicand, coefficient. Product of their exact factors must equal the independently computed characteristic polynomial.
entropy.splitting_field_names: Q or Q(sqrt(d)); a real quadratic lies in the frozen carrier only for d=2,n=8 or d=5,n=5. Compositum degree is phi(n) times extension degree.
entropy.dependence_arguments: Distinct nonzero eigenvalue root objects in spectrum order, including 1 if present.
entropy.dependence_generators: Sorted prime generators {kind:prime,value:integer}; if a quadratic pair is present append {kind:quadratic_ratio,numerator:qplus-root,denominator:qminus-root}.
entropy.dependence_rows: All entries are rational strings. Rational log arguments use prime valuations and zero ratio coordinate. Quadratic conjugate logs use half the prime valuations of their rational norm, and respectively minus or plus 1/2 in the ratio coordinate.
entropy.dependence_basis: Greedy first linearly independent rows in argument order under exact Q row elimination; coordinates are the unique coefficients expressing each original row in this selected row basis. Zero rows have all-zero coordinates. This is the Q basis of the actual eigenvalue-log span. No numerical independence test.
entropy.purity: PURE or MIXED; computed by exact sum of squared eigenvalues, with PSD and trace one checked first.
entropy.renyi2_power_sum: Tr(rho^2), a rational string; this is the power sum, not the logarithmic Renyi entropy.
entropy.external_rule: Requesting an external interval returns the external verdict only after a rational entropy interval of width <= 2^-k is established; its separate record names the absolute-error metric. Computational budget refusal is a separate exception, never a negative theorem or fabricated entropy verdict.
entropy.report: {authority_effect:None,schema:c750_b01_exact_v1,cases:[{input:fixture,output:output}]}; external approximation records are separate and are not required in the cross-language kernel report.
entropy.bounded_scope: The exact spectrum/dependence report supports rational real-symmetric density matrices of dimension <=5 whose characteristic polynomial splits into rational factors and at most one distinct quadratic conjugate pair, including a repeated quadratic factor. Graph component size is not an admission condition. General rational-matrix verdicts and entropy intervals have separate interfaces and do not claim that arbitrary splitting fields or dependence relations were computed. Launch bounds remain unchanged; unsupported spectrum shapes and exhausted budgets are distinct refusals.
entropy.frozen_class_limit: S8 describes a two-dimensional [[4,2,2]] code space in dimension four while invoking four-qubit factorization; this is retained as unresolved. S8 fixtures are explicitly dimension-only proxies and cannot certify its claimed code support or channels.

entropy_definitions.log_branch: Real natural logarithm of strictly positive algebraic eigenvalues under the declared real embedding.
entropy_definitions.zero_convention: The summand at eigenvalue zero is exactly zero without evaluating log(0).
entropy_definitions.shannon: H(p) = -sum_i p_i ln(p_i) for finite nonnegative algebraic p with sum one.
entropy_definitions.renyi_integer_order: H_alpha = ln(sum_i lambda_i^alpha)/(1-alpha), integer alpha>=2. The power sum is algebraic; this definition does not claim the logarithmic entropy is algebraic.

entropy-verdict.scope: Exact rational PSD verdict and bounded certified entropy approximation; not a general splitting-field or logarithm-dependence implementation.

cyclotomic-characteristic.scope: Frozen cyclotomic scalar fields with existing system restrictions; S8 remains an explicit dimension-only proxy, not code-support evidence.
